events.title: 노츠 카운티 keep their survival hopes alive with a 4–0 home win over 울버햄프턴 원더러스.
맨체스터 시티's hopes of an immediate return to the First Division are ended by a 2–0 home defeat to 첼시.

The First Division title race continues as 리버풀 are held to a goalless draw at 버밍엄 시티, while 맨체스터 유나이티드 draw 1–1 with 에버턴 at Goodison Park. QPR keep up their title push with a 3–0 away win over 노츠 카운티, in which Clive Allen scores a hat-trick, leaving the home side needing to win their final three games to stand any chance of survival. 더비 카운티 are on the brink of going down to the Third Division a mere nine years after being First Division champions, after a 4–0 away defeat to 뉴캐슬 유나이티드, who now need just a point from their final two games to be sure of ending their six-year absence from the First Division.

리버풀 are now just two points away from being league champions for the third successive season, having beaten 코번트리 시티 5–0 at Anfield while 맨체스터 유나이티드 lose 2–1 at home to 입스위치 타운. 노츠 카운티's relegation is confirmed when they fail to break the deadlock against 선덜랜드 in a goalless draw at Roker Park . 노팅엄 포리스트's 5–1 home win over 왓퍼드 books them a second successive UEFA Cup campaign. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 secure their return to the First Division with a 2–2 draw against 허더즈필드 타운 at Leeds Road . 올덤 애슬레틱's 2–1 home win over 그림즈비 타운 confirms 더비 카운티's relegation to the Third Division
토트넘 홋스퍼 draw 1–1 with 안더레흐트 in the first leg of the UEFA Cup Final in Brussels .
Ray Wilkins accepts an offer to join AC 밀란 from 맨체스터 유나이티드 in a £1.5 million deal at the end of the season.

리버풀's third successive league title (and 15th overall) is confirmed when they draw 0–0 at 노츠 카운티 and their last remaining rivals 맨체스터 유나이티드 are held to a 1–1 draw at 토트넘 홋스퍼, and outsiders 사우샘프턴 are held to a goalless draw at Birmingham, who are relegated after 코번트리 시티 and 스토크 시티 both win their final games of the season. 첼시 seal the Second Division title on goal difference ahead of 셰필드 웬즈데이.

Alan Mullery departs 크리스털 팰리스 , ostensibly "by mutual consent" though Palace players suspect the sack. Meanwhile, veteran player Archie Gemmill is one of eight released by 더비 카운티, who will spend their centenary season in the Third Division.
Italian giants 유벤투스 FC claims the European Cup Winners' Cup by defeating first-time European finalists 포르투 2–1 .
노팅엄 포리스트 beat 맨체스터 유나이티드 2–0 to leapfrog their opponents in second place in the First Division on goal difference.

In the last match of the First Division season, 사우샘프턴 beat 노츠 카운티 3–1 to finish in second place – the highest finish in their history – while 노팅엄 포리스트, 맨체스터 유나이티드 and QPR complete the top five and qualify for the UEFA Cup.
에버턴 win their first major trophy in 14 years by defeating 왓퍼드 2–0 in the FA Cup final with goals from Graeme Sharp and Andy Gray . This gives them entry to next season's European Cup Winners' Cup .
PFA Young Player of the Year Paul Walsh joins 리버풀 from 루턴 타운 for £700,000 as manager Joe Fagan lines him up as a potential long-term successor to the 33-year-old 케니 달글리시.
토트넘 홋스퍼 draw 1–1 with 안더레흐트 in the UEFA Cup final second leg at White Hart Lane , and win 4–3 on penalties to lift the trophy.
토트넘 홋스퍼 wins the UEFA Cup by defeating R.S.C. 안더레흐트 on penalties (4-3) after an aggregate score of 2–2 at White Hart Lane in London .
에버턴 pay 선덜랜드 £425,000 for 22-year-old midfielder Paul Bracewell .
리버풀 lift the European Cup , beating A.S. Roma 4–2 on penalties after a 1–1 draw in Rome . They become the first English team to win three major competitions in the same season.
Keith Burkinshaw is succeeded as 토트넘 홋스퍼 manager by his assistant Peter Shreeves .
